question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
-- Get top 3 combined points from constructor's best driver and constructor itself
WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        c.name as constructor_name,
        MAX(cs.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id, c.name
),
best_driver_points AS (
    SELECT 
        tdr.year,
        tdr.constructor_id,
        MAX(ds.points) as best_driver_total_points
    FROM team_driver_ranks tdr
    JOIN races r ON r.year = tdr.year
    JOIN driver_standings ds ON tdr.driver_id = ds.driver_id AND ds.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE TRY_CAST(CAST(tdr.team_driver_rank AS VARCHAR) AS INTEGER) = 1
    GROUP BY tdr.year, tdr.constructor_id
)
SELECT 
    csp.constructor_name,
    csp.year,
    csp.constructor_total_points + bdp.best_driver_total_points as combined_points
FROM constructor_season_points csp
JOIN best_driver_points bdp ON csp.constructor_id = bdp.constructor_id AND csp.year = bdp.year
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (csp.constructor_total_points + bdp.best_driver_total_points) DESC) <= 3
